Five years before presentation laparoscopic surgery for a recurrent left ovarian endometrioma was aborted because of severe adhesions. The cyst reached 7 cm and a left ovarian cystectomy by laparotomy was performed. Persistent postoperative pain was treated with a GnRH antagonist for 3 months. Two months before presentation she was hospitalized with lower abdominal pain and fever and was diagnosed with PID and an endometrioma with abscess.
